question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Rajib's research aims to identify the strings that connect man and nature in order to provide a comprehensive examination and asessment of a variety of ecological issues.
solution:
The correct answer is '**asessment**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**asessment**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**assessment**'.
 
• **Assessment** - the action of assessing someone or something. (मूल्यांकन)
 
 
• *Example: The teacher gave us a weekly **assessment** to measure our progress in the course.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__*** asessment.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Strings** - a thin piece of cord, fiber, or similar material used for tying, binding, or hanging things. (स्ट्रिंग)
 
• **Ecological** - relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings. (पारिस्थितिकी)
 
• **Comprehensive** - complete; including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something. (विस्तृत)
